passage.label: O believed fear Allah let every soul look what put forth tomorrow fear Allah Acquainted what do; be not like those forgot Allah made forget themselves defiantly disobedient; not equal companions Fire companions Paradise attainers success; if sent Quran upon mountain seen humbled coming apart fear Allah examples presented perhaps give thought; He Allah no deity Knower unseen witnessed Entirely Merciful Especially Merciful; He Allah no deity Sovereign Pure Perfection Bestower Faith Overseer Exalted Might Compeller Superior exalted above associate; He Allah Creator Inventor Fashioner best names whatever heavens earth exalting Exalted Might Wise

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَلۡتَنظُرۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّا قَدَّمَتۡ لِغَدٖۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
وَلَا تَكُونُواْ كَٱلَّذِينَ نَسُواْ ٱللَّهَ فَأَنسَىٰهُمۡ أَنفُسَهُمۡۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ
لَا يَسۡتَوِيٓ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِۚ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ هُمُ ٱلۡفَآئِزُونَ
لَوۡ أَنزَلۡنَا هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٖ لَّرَأَيۡتَهُۥ خَٰشِعٗا مُّتَصَدِّعٗا مِّنۡ خَشۡيَةِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلُ نَضۡرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِۖ هُوَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَٰمُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُ ٱلۡمُهَيۡمِنُ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡجَبَّارُ ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُ ٱلۡبَارِئُ ٱلۡمُصَوِّرُۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

mainSubject.label: Believers commanded to fear Allah and let every soul examine what it has sent ahead for tomorrow, repeated under His acquaintance with their deeds; warning against resembling those who forgot Allah so He made them forget themselves, named defiantly disobedient; the inequality of Fire-companions and Paradise-companions, the latter being the attainers of success; the parable of a mountain humbling and splitting apart from fear of Allah had the Quran descended upon it, presented so people reflect; the closing name-sequence declaring Allah alone as deity, Knower of unseen and witnessed, Entirely and Especially Merciful, then Sovereign, Pure, Perfection, Bestower of Faith, Overseer, Mighty, Compeller and Superior exalted above association, then Creator, Inventor and Fashioner owning the best names with all creation exalting Him, the Mighty and Wise

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the palm-tree permission ruling (5) before the fay' distribution block opens (6); P2 ends with the later-generations supplication (10) before the hypocrite-alliance critique begins (11); P3 runs through their broken promises, the Satan parable and the shared Fire outcome (11-17); P4 covers the self-examination command, the forgetting warning, the mountain parable and the closing divine-name sequence (18-24).
